Thanks again for your time on the call earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we all have the same view: 

Summary from today's call:
- FinBank is evaluating Redwood for real-time inference across customer-facing workflows with strict key management requirements and SOC 2 / HIPAA considerations.
- Primary asks: SOC 2 Type II evidence, GDPR/HIPAA mapping, support for customer-managed keys (BYOK) and HSM integration, and details on encryption at-rest and in-transit.

Short answers (details below and attached):
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ with forward secrecy (all hosted traffic).
- Encryption at rest: AES-256 envelope encryption by default.
- KMS / BYOK: Hosted API supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (CMKs) and Azure Key Vault wrap/unwrap. For Private deployments we support integration with customer HSMs and KMIP-compatible appliances.
- HSMs & compliance: Private deployments can be configured to use customer HSMs (Thales, Gemalto, AWS CloudHSM) and we support KMIP or cloud-native HSM APIs.
- Audit & key access: Key usage is logged in audit trails; we provide key-access events and can include key IDs in request logs for correlation (masked where required).

Hi Tom —

Thanks for the questions — I'm Marissa (Sales Engineer). Quick technical notes to address the items you raised: 

HSM / KMIP support:
- Private deployments: full support for on-prem KMIP endpoints (Thales, Utimaco, etc.). In a Private deployment the key operations (wrap/unwrap) can be performed entirely inside your network; no key material leaves your HSM. We typically recommend a VPN or dedicated transit for initial provisioning; runtime operations remain local when configured that way.
- Hosted API: we support BYOK via cloud KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, Google KMS). For customers wanting HSM-backed CMKs in the cloud, we integrate with AWS CloudHSM / AWS KMS custom key stores where available.

Key rotation & downtime:
- Hosted CMK rotation: supported with seamless re-wrap flow. We use envelope encryption (data keys generated by KMS, wrapped by your CMK). Rotating the CMK triggers re-wrapping of new data keys; existing ciphertext remains decryptable with previous key versions for a configurable grace period — no planned downtime.
- Private deployments: rotation policies are driven by the customer HSM; we can coordinate to ensure zero-downtime rotations via staged key-promotion.

Retention of key material:
- Redwood never persists plaintext customer master keys. For hosted CMK workflows we never store unwrapped CMKs; data keys are encrypted (wrapped) with the customer CMK and stored as ciphertext.

Auditability & compliance artifacts:
- We provide key usage logs, per-request audit events, and can supply filtered logs for your auditors.
- SOC 2: our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30. I will share the report and SSP via the Drive link (we'll provide a limited-access copy).
